name: SOAR-based Adaptive Refinement
aliases: Lindstrom and Pascucci's SOAR algorithm adaptation
definition: An adaptive refinement scheme for crack-free mesh generation. It stores object-space error terms and bounding spheres for each 'diamond' (two cousin patches sharing a hypotenuse). Errors and spheres are inflated to ensure parent values are at least as large as children's, and cousins agree on single error/sphere values to refine together. This nesting is enforced for cousins as well.
